payloads.name: PatchDL
payloads.description: Downloads official, unmodified game updates for games already installed on the console. Includes clearer download failure diagnostics and marks sideloaded apps so bulk updates leave them unchanged.

payloads.name: Orbit Store
payloads.description: A modern PS5 download manager with a native TV app (FFPKG and ELF), phone controls, Archive.org sign-in, improved host downloads, and Orbit Zero desktop clients for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

payloads.name: PS5 Game Compressor
payloads.description: PS5 game compression utility. Latest listed stable release v1.1.1.

payloads.name: PS5 Game Compressor (Arabic RTL)
payloads.description: PS5 game compression utility with Arabic support and a right-to-left interface.

payloads.name: PS5SX2 Installer
payloads.description: Installer ELF for PS5SX2, a PS2 emulator for jailbroken PS5.

payloads.name: PS5SX2 Helper
payloads.description: Helper ELF for PS5SX2, a PS2 emulator for jailbroken PS5.

payloads.name: SwanStationPS5 Disc Daemon
payloads.description: Disc daemon ELF accompanying SwanStationPS5, a PS1 emulator for jailbroken PS5.

payloads.name: BlackBox
payloads.description: BlackBox PS5 utility, release 1.11.0.

payloads.name: Enable-Disable-UPD-PS5
payloads.description: Payload to enable or disable PS5 system software updates.

payloads.name: RecompStore Installer
payloads.description: Installer ELF for Recomp Store, a PS5 homebrew application store.

payloads.name: AnyPad PS5 English
payloads.description: PS5 controller compatibility payload, release 0.5.5-beta.

payloads.name: PS5 Account Tools
payloads.description: Payload that exposes local PS5 account management tools over a web server on port 6769.

payloads.name: PS5 Linux Loader
payloads.description: Loader payload for running Linux on PS5.

payloads.name: Pegasus DL
payloads.description: Direct package downloading from a jailbroken PS5.

payloads.name: Full Y2JB Block
payloads.description: Full Y2JB Block payload distributed by PS5 Y2JB USBUtilityTool.

payloads.name: pLinux5-NG Offsets
payloads.description: Offsets ELF associated with pLinux5-NG, a work-in-progress PS5 Linux project targeting high firmware versions. This is an offsets payload, not a complete Linux loader or Linux image.

payloads.name: Y2JB Update Blocker
payloads.description: PS5 payload for blocking YouTube update metadata; v1.0.1 adds title-ID support and verifies database/metadata changes.

payloads.name: PS5 Linux Autoloader
payloads.description: Installer ELF for the PS5 Linux Autoloader project.

payloads.name: PS5 Linux Loader (soniciso1)
payloads.description: Direct ELF asset from soniciso1's PS5 Linux Loader release. Release notes specify 10.xx support for PS5 Fat/Slim, not Pro; this project is separate from ps5-linux/ps5-linux-loader.

payloads.name: Prospero Menu
payloads.description: Direct ELF release asset for Prospero Menu.

payloads.name: PS5 Payload Manager (PLDMGR)
payloads.description: Web-based PS5 payload manager dashboard to import, manage, and autoload payloads; recommended with a PS5 autoloader.

payloads.name: PS5 ELF Loader (elfldr)
payloads.description: Direct ELF release asset for PS5 ELF Loader (elfldr).

payloads.name: PS5 Unified Autoloader
payloads.description: Direct ELF release asset for PS5 Unified Autoloader.

payloads.name: HYPERHEN
payloads.description: Direct ELF release asset for HYPERHEN v0.9.2.

payloads.name: WK Store Installer
payloads.description: Installer ELF for WK Store v1.2.4, which replaces the PS5 Store tile with a jailbreak launcher that opens bundled Elf Launcher 2.1.6 when the chain finishes. Send to elfldr on port 9021; if WK Store is already installed, send the Restore ELF first and reopen elfldr, then send this installer. The console reboots itself when installation finishes. Wobkot offsets cover 6.00/6.02 through 13.60 as listed upstream; Relapse covers 7.00–13.60. Works offline after install.

payloads.name: Elf Launcher
payloads.description: Official PS5 Elf Launcher ELF payload release v2.0.5.

payloads.name: PS5 Web Browser Fullscreen
payloads.description: Opens the PS5 web browser in fullscreen at 1920×1080 while preserving normal controller input and localhost access. The project author reports testing on firmware 4.03, 12.20 and 13.60; this is a prerelease test build and should be used at your own risk.

payloads.name: PS5 Web Browser Fullscreen — Restore
payloads.description: Companion restore payload that returns the PS5 web browser to its ordinary layout without rebooting. Prerelease test build; close and reopen the browser after running it.

payloads.name: PS5 Bazzite Deck
payloads.description: Bazzite (SteamOS-style Linux) image for the PS5 with Steam Gaming Mode and a KDE desktop, shipped as a single bootc image that updates in place with 'sudo bootc upgrade'. Runs from a USB drive or the M.2 slot and leaves the PS5 system untouched; this ELF is the loader that starts it and is based on the ps5-linux-loader project. Use the release marked Latest (pre-releases are test builds); install prerequisites and per-model limitations are on wiki.ps5-linux.eu.

payloads.name: Kraken Mount
payloads.description: Experimental PS5 ELF payload that registers games from debug FPKG .pkg files or game folders (plain, zstd or LZ4 packs) without installing them, adds a home-screen tile per title and launches it through a bundled ampr-emu-ng runtime. Scans the internal SSD plus USB and extended drives, caches games on internal storage and serves a web UI on port 8097; elfldr must be running. The author reports only a small number of games tested so far and that .pkg support is the newest and least tested path.

payloads.name: Kite Pack
payloads.description: Desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that packs your own PS5 game dumps with zstd into folder, exFAT, .ffpkg or .ffpfs copies and sends them over Wi-Fi to a jailbroken PS5; this release asset is the PS5-side kite-helper.elf, which needs an ELF loader (port 9021) and ShadowMount+ watching the destination folder (/data/homebrew by default). Packing uses PS5 Dump Forge and transfers use AVA1; builds are unsigned, DLC installation is not included yet, and it does not include or download games.

payloads.name: TITAN CORE
payloads.description: PS5 game workspace with native FPKG engine, external-drive installer and live diagnostics. Bundles kstuff-lite and ShadowMountPlus; starts them automatically. Requires a jailbroken PS5 with elfldr. Dashboard, library, USB browser, cache builder and 31 language/localization support. Arabic RTL, themes, controller-friendly navigation.

payloads.name: BrowserPS5
payloads.description: One-file installer ELF for BrowserPS5, a native PS5 title (PPSA97024) with a WebKit 627.1.7 browser, JavaScript JIT, GPU rendering and DualSense controls. Run once, then open BrowserPS5 from Games; do not add it to an autoload list. Needs a jailbroken PS5 with an ELF loader on port 9021 (etaHEN) and ShadowMountPlus running every time the browser opens. Tested on one PS5 on firmware 13.60 only. No DRM video, no WebRTC, up to 6 tabs sharing 1 GiB. rc13 fixes the missing /user/homebrew/browserps5/data/tmp folder that made rc12 close at startup.

payloads.name: BrowserPS5 Uninstall
payloads.description: Uninstaller ELF for BrowserPS5: removes the installed title and browser files and asks ShadowMountPlus to remove the Games-tab tile. Favorites, history, settings and saved logins are kept for a later install; downloaded files are not touched. Needs the PS5 jailbreak setup: ELF loader on port 9021 and ShadowMountPlus.

payloads.name: BrowserPS5 Uninstall All
payloads.description: Uninstaller ELF for BrowserPS5 that removes the installed title and browser files, the Games-tab tile, and the saved favorites, history, settings and logins. Downloaded files are not touched. Needs the PS5 jailbreak setup: ELF loader on port 9021 and ShadowMountPlus.

payloads.name: WK Store Restore
payloads.description: Restore ELF for WK Store v1.2.4: puts the original PlayStation Store tile back. Send to elfldr on port 9021; no reboot is needed after Restore. Use it before every WK Store upgrade when WK Store is already installed.

payloads.name: NoUpdate
payloads.description: NoUpdate v1.0.0 payload ELF for a jailbroken PS5: clears the "Update Required" launch block on installed games by auto-detecting titles and patching update-related checks globally in memory, with backed-up persistent metadata edits when needed. Manual launch only; the first run needs a one-time PS5 restart, and re-launch afterwards to reapply the temporary memory patch. Targeted at firmware 6.xx–13.60 but tested only on 10.01. Offline single-player use on your own console; it does not add missing firmware features or guarantee game compatibility.

payloads.name: PSWloader
payloads.description: PS5-side loader ELF for PSWloader: boots a custom UEFI firmware so stock Windows 11 runs natively on the console hardware with PatchGuard on. Requires a payload-capable PS5, a USB stick with the official Windows 11 ISO and a target M.2 SSD or USB drive; tested on system software 13.60. Windows uses test-signing mode for the unsigned PS5 drivers, so some anti-cheat games will not launch; Bluetooth, audio and in-Windows resolution changes are not supported yet.
